metadata.name: penlight
metadata.description: Sealed lots of real tokens, sold on a falling clock inside a private rollup

instructions.name: create_house_lot
docs: The House opens a lot that the seed will pack from its pool.

instructions.name: create_lot
docs: A seller consigns a lot. The commitment binds its contents before anything
else can happen to it.

instructions.name: delegate_lot
docs: Hands the lot and its seal to the private rollup.

instructions.name: delegate_pool
docs: Hands the pool ledger to the private rollup.

instructions.name: deliver
docs: Moves an opened lot's tokens: to the winner if it sold, back to the seller
if it didn't. House lots pay out of (or release) their pool reservation.
Permissionless.
remaining_accounts: [source_ata, destination_ata] for each slot with an
amount, in slot order (none for an unsold House lot).

instructions.name: go_live
docs: Posts the sealed lot to Solana and starts the clock a moment later.
Permissionless.

instructions.name: init_house
docs: Creates the House and its pool ledger.

instructions.name: on_shuffle
docs: VRF callback. The seed goes into the seal, not the public lot: nobody can
predict the facts before they come out.

instructions.name: open
docs: Asks the VRF oracle — from inside the enclave — for the seed that decides
which facts the lot will disclose (and, for House lots, what goes in).

instructions.name: pack
docs: A seller moves their tokens into the lot's own accounts, checked against
the commitment (which covers every catalogue slot, empty ones included).
remaining_accounts: [seller_ata, lot_ata] for each slot with amount > 0,
in slot order. The rollup does not show this transaction to outsiders.

instructions.name: pack_from_pool
docs: House lots: the seed draws the contents from what the pool has free, and
reserves them. Permissionless.
remaining_accounts: pool_ata × SLOTS, feed × SLOTS.

instructions.name: pool_permission
docs: Makes the pool ledger unreadable: no members, so only the program sees it.

instructions.name: reveal
docs: Writes every fact that is due into the public lot. Permissionless; the
facts are computed here, inside the enclave, from the seal and live prices.
remaining_accounts: feed × SLOTS.

instructions.name: seal_permission
docs: Locks the seal behind a permission. Consigned lots let their seller read it
(they packed it); House lots have no reader at all.

instructions.name: set_catalogue
docs: Only before the first lot: every lot reads the catalogue, so it never
changes under a lot.

instructions.name: settle
docs: Commits the finished lot to Solana and returns it there for good.

instructions.name: take
docs: The race. Pays the clock price of the block this lands in and takes the
lot. Payment and title move in this one transaction.

instructions.name: unseal
docs: Opens a sold lot — or a lot whose clock ran out — inside the enclave:
contents, salt and seed become public and the live oracle values them.
Permissionless. remaining_accounts: feed × SLOTS.

errors.name: BadPrices
errors.msg: start price must exceed a non-zero floor

errors.name: BadDuration
errors.msg: clock length must be positive

errors.name: WrongStatus
errors.msg: lot is not in the right state for this

errors.name: BadAccounts
errors.msg: account list does not match the lot

errors.name: CommitmentMismatch
errors.msg: contents do not match the commitment

errors.name: PriceAboveLimit
errors.msg: clock price is above your limit

errors.name: SellerCannotTake
errors.msg: the seller cannot take their own lot

errors.name: NotHouseAuthority
errors.msg: only the house authority can do this

errors.name: BadCatalogue
errors.msg: catalogue entry is malformed

errors.name: EmptyLot
errors.msg: the lot has no contents

errors.name: TooEarly
errors.msg: the clock has not reached this point yet

errors.name: OracleWrongFeed
errors.msg: oracle account is not the expected feed

errors.name: OracleUnverified
errors.msg: oracle update is not a verified republisher update

errors.name: OracleStale
errors.msg: oracle price is stale

errors.name: OracleBadValue
errors.msg: oracle price is out of range

errors.name: Overflow
errors.msg: arithmetic overflow

errors.name: PoolTooSmall
errors.msg: the pool cannot cover a draw

errors.name: NotSealed
errors.msg: the private permission must exist before this

errors.name: WrongValidator
errors.msg: lots may only be delegated to the House's private-rollup validator

errors.name: CatalogueFrozen
errors.msg: the catalogue is fixed once lots exist

fields.name: feed
docs: MagicBlock oracle feed account (also the stored feed id).

fields.name: expo
docs: Magnitude of the feed-list exponent (price = raw / 10^expo).

fields.name: slot
docs: The clock slot this fact was due at.

fields.name: validator
docs: The private-rollup (TEE) validator lots and the pool may be delegated to.

types.name: Lot
docs: Public state of a lot. Everything a bidder needs is here; nothing in here says
what is inside until the lot is opened.

fields.name: sealed
docs: Set once the seal's permission exists; nothing touches the seal before.

fields.name: hint_prices
docs: Oracle prices each fact was computed with (public data), so anyone can
re-derive every fact exactly once the lot is opened.

fields.name: value_at_delivery
docs: Micro-dollar value of the contents at delivery, from the live oracle.

fields.name: amounts
docs: Published when the lot is opened.

types.name: Pool
docs: The House pool's private ledger. Pool tokens stay in the pool's own accounts;
a House lot is a reservation against them until it is delivered.

fields.name: private
docs: Set once the ledger's no-reader permission exists.

types.name: Seal
docs: Private state of a lot. Lives in the enclave behind a permission with no
readers; only the program touches it.
